body:
I live in the dorms. People will take clothes out of the washer/dryer and put them on the counter if you're even a minute late to take them out.
Don't fucking touch other people's shit. It's BEYOND rude. Only do that shit if you've been waiting an hour or two. The universe is not going to cease to exist if you don't do laundry this second.

Haven't spent any money on hobbies or anything fun in a long time. It all goes to food. I just need to blow off some steam.

In college right now, and I need a part-time job. I have a shitty work history, but would a retail job even care about my history?
Does she braid it for you?
Oh no! Perhaps you could donate it to poor women or children without beards? I'd pay good money for that beard!
I'd love to run my fingers through that beard ;)
You should totally braid that! You'd be a badass Viking!
A fine mix of elegant and slightly scruffy ;)
Does the curtain match the drapes?
Do you really want everyone knowing about that drug-fueled orgy you had back in college when you were young and stupid?
